comments.text: This is morally reprehensible. Who was the donor of this brain tissue? I read of this being performed by another commercial company in Australia, the Doom idea was borrowed from a lab using rodent brains. The company in Australia was punishing the neuron by placing the wafers of brain tissue in a cold dark pantry, the brain tissue that was to be rewarded received light and vibrational stimuli. The limitation of this bio-hybrid chip is that you must feed the tissues, keep them free of infection, keep steady and consistent temperature,  protect the neurons from directional disorientation, also must be concerned with disease (like dementia), and general aging issues.
